title: Martial Exertion Gloves
summary: Take 6d6 Piercing damage to gain one extra attack and double movement speed in combat.

fields.Martial Exertion: Free action on yourself in combat, once per Short Rest. You take 6d6 Piercing. Gain one additional attack and doubled movement for 1 turn. The extra attack stacks with Extra Attack but does not trigger it. The doubled movement ends when you take the extra attack.
fields.Acquisition: Buy from Bumpnagel in the Rivington General cellar.
fields.Base value: 160 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Honour Mode: Very Rare, with a base value of 580 gp.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
